requirements.quote: The "QUIC Transport Error Codes" registry governs a 62-bit space.
requirements.condition: When representing or validating a QUIC transport error code.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the transport error-code space as 62 bits wide.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not accept transport error-code values outside the 62-bit space.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's accepted numeric range or encoding bounds can be inspected or tested.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x00.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as NO_ERROR, meaning no error.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x01.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as INTERNAL_ERROR, meaning an implementation error.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x02.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as CONNECTION_REFUSED, meaning the server refuses a connection.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x03.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR, meaning a flow-control error.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x04.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR, meaning too many streams were opened.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x05.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as STREAM_STATE_ERROR, meaning a frame was received in an invalid stream state.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x06.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as FINAL_SIZE_ERROR, meaning a change to final size.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x07.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR, meaning a frame-encoding error.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x08.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR, meaning an error in transport parameters.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x09.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR, meaning too many connection IDs were received.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x0a.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as PROTOCOL_VIOLATION, meaning a generic protocol violation.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x0b.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as INVALID_TOKEN, meaning an invalid Token was received.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x0c.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as APPLICATION_ERROR, meaning an application error.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x0d.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED, meaning the CRYPTO data buffer overflowed.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x0e.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as KEY_UPDATE_ERROR, meaning an invalid packet-protection update.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x0f.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as AEAD_LIMIT_REACHED, meaning excessive use of packet-protection keys.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is 0x10.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as NO_VIABLE_PATH, meaning no viable network path exists.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric-to-symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.

requirements.condition: When the QUIC transport error-code value is in the inclusive range 0x0100 through 0x01ff.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret or expose the code as CRYPTO_ERROR associated with a TLS alert code.
requirements.why_checkable: The inclusive numeric range and its symbolic error-code mapping can be checked directly.
